album.title: Family album
album.empty: No generation has handed the farm on yet.
album.story.first: They started with a small field and a big sky.
album.story.challenge: They chose the hard road, and the seeds showed it.
album.story.GreenThumb: Everything they planted seemed to want to grow.
album.story.QuickHands: Their hands never stopped moving over the beds.
album.story.Merchant: They knew the price of everything in the Almanac.
album.story.Steady: Year after year, the harvest came in.
album.story.Watchful: Not a crow got past them.

ui.seed_hint: Pick a seed, then tap a plot
ui.end_year_body: Winter starts at once. Crops that are not ripe yet are lost, as they would be to the frost.
tip.0: Slide the ring over ripe crops to harvest them.
tip.1: Tap a crow to scare it off before it eats the crop.
tip.2: Harvest without a break to build a combo.
tip.3: Irrigation and helpers keep working while you are away.
tip.4: Passing the farm on earns seeds for stronger generations.
tip.5: In summer, tap the rain cloud to water the whole field.

hint.first_frost: Frost is coming — harvest what you can!
hint.first_winter: Spend your coins. Bigger ring, or water while you're away?

gen.title: Generation {gen}
gen.flavour.2: The barn keys change hands. The well still works.
gen.flavour.3: Someone planted a tree by the gate.
gen.flavour.4: The fence needed mending. It got mended.
gen.flavour.5: A second floor for the house, and a view of the field.
gen.flavour.6: The windmill turns even when nobody is watching.
gen.flavour.7: The old almanac is full of notes in three hands.
gen.flavour.8: Neighbours come to see the field now.
gen.flavour.9: The crows have learned to keep their distance.
gen.flavour.10: Ten generations. The soil remembers every one.
away.nothing: Nothing grew on its own yet.
